title: IDF Strike on Gaza City Residential Building Kills At Least 10, Including Four Children — Day 960
detail: An Israeli airstrike struck a residential building in Gaza City on May 28, 2026 (Day 960), killing at least 10 people including four children, and injuring more than 20 others. Al Jazeera confirmed the strike and casualty figures. The attack continued the pattern of near-daily Israeli airstrikes on residential structures in the Gaza City area since the renewal of military operations on May 11. Palestinian Civil Defense teams worked to recover bodies and treat the wounded at the scene. Hospitals in the area, already overwhelmed, received the casualties amid critical shortages of medicine and surgical supplies. The strike came one day after Hamas confirmed the death of Mohammed Odeh — the fourth commander of the Qassam Brigades killed since October 7 — and amid the post-Eid al-Adha period when Palestinians across Gaza had hoped for a reduction in violence.

media.caption: IDF strike on Gaza City residential building kills at least 10 including four children — May 28, 2026

title: Hamas Gaza City Brigade Deputy Commander Imad Aslim Killed in IDF Strike — Day 960
detail: Imad Aslim, deputy commander of Hamas's Gaza City Brigade and commander of its Zeitoun Battalion, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on May 28, 2026 (Day 960). The Times of Israel reported the killing and noted that Izz ad-Din Beck, commander of Hamas's Northern Gaza Brigade, was also reportedly present at the targeted site. Aslim's funeral was held in Gaza City on May 29. The killing continued Israel's sustained campaign of decapitating Hamas's military command structure: Mohammed Deif (July 2024), Yahya Sinwar (October 2024), Mohammed Sinwar (May 13, 2026), Izz al-Din al-Haddad (May 16, 2026), and Mohammed Odeh (May 26, 2026) were all eliminated in quick succession. Hamas has consistently refilled command positions, though analysts note each killing represents a degradation of experienced leadership.

media.caption: Hamas Gaza City Brigade deputy commander Imad Aslim killed in IDF strike — funeral held in Gaza City May 29, 2026

title: US Returns Palestinian Rights Expert Francesca Albanese to Sanctions List
detail: The United States has reinstated Palestinian rights expert and UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese on its sanctions list, a move that draws significant criticism from human rights advocates and further strains international accountability mechanisms surrounding the Gaza conflict. Albanese has been one of the most vocal critics of Israeli military operations and had previously been removed from the list.

media.caption: US reinstates sanctions against UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese
